note: Native build: browser WebSocket API only; the "SDK" is our own adapter, so this measures the adapter itself.
no React UI kit for this platform
Sendbird: @sendbird/chat with GroupChannelModule only (no OpenChannel/Feed modules).
Sendbird UIKit for React: SendbirdProvider + GroupChannel + CSS, React externalised.
Stream: stream-chat JS client, connect + watch + send + message.new.
stream-chat-react: Chat + Channel + Window + MessageList + MessageComposer + CSS, React externalised.
TalkJS: @talkjs/core headless Data API (session, conversation, send, subscribe). The Components SDK is in the kit entry.
TalkJS Components SDK: @talkjs/react-components Chatbox + default.css (renders in the page, not an iframe), React externalised.
CometChat UI Kit v7: CometChatProvider + MessageList + MessageComposer (CSS is injected by the kit), React externalised.
